## 4. Flying 10s

Exercise Objective: Develop proper stride length and stride frequency

## Procedure

1. Begin jogging at half speed, increasing speed with each stride for the first 30 yards so maximal velocity is attained by the 30-yard mark (-15)
2. Continue to sprint at maximum velocity for 10 yards before decelerating gradually

## Coaching Points

- A maximal sprint should be performed for the entire 10 yards
- Make sure proper sprinting technique is employed throughout the drill
